statement.p: Its given that 58\cdot58=3364. Use this fact to calculate the following without using a calculator.

solution.p: There is no operation symbol between 0.58 and -0.058, which implies multiplication.
Next, since positive times negative is negative, we know the answer must be negative. Now we can focus on calculating 0.58 \cdot 0.058, and in the end add back the negative symbol.
